WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW   Backflush costing
With JIT, work in process is small, so some companies use backflush costing: they record costs only at a few trigger points, such as completion or sale. Under U.S. GAAP this is acceptable only when the result is close to what full costing would give (ASC 330).

FALSE-FRIEND ALERT   PGI, تخطيط موارد المؤسسة
French often says 'progiciel de gestion intégré (PGI)' for ERP. The Arabic تخطيط موارد المؤسسة translates the English name; both mean the integrated system, not only planning.

WORKED EXAMPLE   Worked example: printing labels
Beverages prints its own labels at a full cost of $265,000, of which $225,000 is avoidable. A printer offers the labels for $200,000, and the freed room can be rented for $12,000. Figure F217-12 shows that buying saves $37,000 a year.
Rent from the freed print room

EXAM TRAP   Full cost is not avoidable cost
If an exam answer compares the supplier's price with the full cost, it counts costs that will not disappear. Compare with the avoidable cost, and add any income from freed resources.
